EXPLANATION: Strong aliphatic C–H stretches at 2875/2931 cm⁻¹ and CH₂/CH₃ deformations at 1443/1462 cm⁻¹ match an alkyl ether (GFQ-003). No O–H stretch in the 3200–3600 cm⁻¹ region is observed, disfavoring the many OH-bearing candidates. Bands near 1041/1058 cm⁻¹ and 907/851 cm⁻¹ are consistent with C–O–C stretching and ring modes of a cyclic ether (tetrahydropyran). The weak 2727 cm⁻¹ feature is compatible with a CH₃ Fermi resonance (SPC-002). CC1CCCCOC1C (candidate 10) best fits these features.
